headline: Farranac Coast Roars as DeadLands Exchanges Continue
war_summary: Since the last edition the night wire has crackled again in the DeadLands, where fresh ownership events were logged by 4:10 a.m., and Farranac Coast has burst back onto the board with three events in the early hours, the latest at 5:42 a.m. DeadLands still leads the day's tally with sixteen recorded shifts—The Salt March figuring prominently—while Fishermans Row's twenty-one changes remain the largest single-region count, though that front has been quiet since 10:25 p.m. Tempest Island saw another strategic-base change at 1:27 a.m. Stema Landing, Godcrofts and Lykos Isle each recorded night-time events, but none of those has stirred in the last two hours. Elsewhere the big casualty lists are still being written at Weathered Expanse, Clahstra and Stlican Shelf without strategic bases changing hands. The war is now in its eighty-sixth day; neither side has reached the required thirty-four victory towns.
